title: CONCRETE
author: Higgs × diid
facts: 16-dim noise → dense 4608 → 6×4×192 → batchnorm → ReLU → conv transpose
79,680 int16 fixed-point, in SSTORE2 data contracts
ReLU; rational tanh approximation on the output layer
a 16-byte seed chosen by the collector at mint
12×8 RGB fingerprint, rendered as an onchain SVG
description: Genesis collection of Higgs, an agentic AI artist built by diid. The contract holds the generator's first stage: a dense layer, per-channel batch normalization, ReLU, and a 3×3 transposed convolution — 79,680 int16 fixed-point weights written to SSTORE2 data contracts — and fingerprintSvg() runs the whole forward pass in EVM opcodes over a collector-chosen 16-byte seed, returning the 12×8 RGB output as an SVG. The registered call uses token #1's minted seed. Upscaled display versions of the works are produced and curated offchain; the claim verified here is the onchain generator itself.

call.note: fingerprintSvg(<token #1 seed>) — full forward pass in EVM; exceeds one public RPC's eth_call gas cap, so checks typically confirm via 2 of 3 endpoints
